# LGD Term Registry v1.1 — llms.txt

> AI-discoverable index of the LGD term-registration repositories (17 -urgy/-ship terms).
> Machine-readable metadata lives in each repo README frontmatter; SHA-256 digests in .well-known/agent-skills/index.json.

Concept DOI: https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.23385209
Registry (execution-layer method): placeholdurgy

[holurgy](https://github.com/zhaoxinghua09-cell/holurgy): Use when the whole is greater than the sum of its parts: factors, structure, emergence. 当涉及'整体大于部分之和'的整合（因素→结构→涌现）时使用。

[axiurgy](https://github.com/zhaoxinghua09-cell/axiurgy): Use when defining what deserves protection and what cannot be compromised in AI governance. 当需要界定 AI 治理中什么值得保护、什么不可妥协时使用
[genoship](https://github.com/zhaoxinghua09-cell/genoship): Use when governing lineage, reproduction, and provenance of autonomous beings. 当需要治理自治之物的血缘、繁殖与来源追溯时使用。
